information: Used to induct a large amount of light through things to refract them. Turns Shadium to Refined Shadium and is powered by a Redstone Block on the back and a Glowine Block on top that is consumed on use.
Refracts only the three blocks in front of it and it's charring explosion can be prevented by covering the sides and bottom with a high-resistance block like obsidian or Strong Titanium Blocks.
